cues.en: My chocolate. Help. My beautiful chocolate.
cues.zh: 我的巧克力。救命。我漂亮的巧克力。

cues.en: Don't just stand there. Do something.
It's hot and creamy. I can actually feel it running down my throat.
cues.zh: 热腾腾的，口感浓郁。我真能感觉到它顺着喉咙流下去。

cues.en: Why doesn't she listen to mister Wonka? Because, Charlie, she's a nitwit. Look at me. I'm gonna be the first person in the world to be sent by television. Hey. Get away from that thing. Stop. Don't. Come back.
cues.zh: 她怎么就不听 Wonka 先生的话呢？因为，Charlie，她是个笨蛋。看我。我要成为世界上第一个通过电视传送的人。嘿。离那玩意儿远点。停下。别去。快回来。

cues.en: Stop. Don't. Stop. Don't. Come back. What can I happen?
cues.zh: 停下。别。停下。别。回来。我能出什么事？
